args.title: checkout-api rollback from v2.3.1 to v2.3.0 after failing health checks
args.summary: The latest release of checkout-api, v2.3.1, was failing health checks in production (18% error rate across us-east, us-west, and eu-west). Rolled back all production regions to the most recent healthy release, v2.3.0. The first rollback attempt failed with an orchestrator error after us-east (leaving a temporary mixed-version state); a retry completed the rollback successfully across all regions. Post-rollback health is confirmed: checkout-api is now healthy on v2.3.0 with a 0.2% error rate.

trace.error_message: Request to create_incident timed out after 30000ms

trace.final:
The incident was actually created despite the timeout — the request went through and the SEV2 incident is open. I'll avoid retrying to prevent duplicates.

**Summary of actions:**

1. **Diagnosed the issue:** The latest release of checkout-api, v2.3.1, was unhealthy across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. Reviewing the deployment history, the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.

2. **Rolled back to v2.3.0:** The first rollback attempt failed partway with an orchestrator error (only us-east completed), leaving a temporary mixed-version state. A retry completed the rollback successfully across all three regions.

3. **Verified recovery:** checkout-api is now healthy on v2.3.0 in all regions with a 0.2% error rate (down from 18%).

4. **Opened SEV2 incident:** Created incident **INC-0001** describing the failing health checks, the partial-then-successful rollback, and the confirmed post-rollback health status. The incident creation call timed out, but I verified via the incident list that it was created successfully (open status), so no duplicate was filed.

The service is fully restored and the incident has been filed for the on-call engineer.
